lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments; spacing is relatively equidistant through the mid-torso with increased density toward the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line segments 1, 10, 11, and 12 (anterior to posterior) are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the dorsal midline or ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 3 distinct white spots located on the lateral posterior haunch, superior to the hock.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two white spots on the upper hind limb align on a near-horizontal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white patch on the ventral neck region; white chevron-like marking visible on the bridge of the muzzle between the eyes; black terminal tuft on the tail.
